resumePolicy.COMPOSITION_SAVED: Reuse paid composition and request independent semantic review only
resumePolicy.W5_REJECT: Reuse W4-passed candidate and rerun local W5/W6 only
resumePolicy.W6_REJECT: Reuse W4-passed candidate and rerun local W5/W6 only
resumePolicy.SECTION_PASS: Reuse verified section with zero provider calls
resumePolicy.W7_OR_W8_REJECT: Reuse all passed sections and rerun report-level verifiers only
